{{Quote|Much later came the Empire, who as we know built into the forbidden mountain. They enslaved many of the native peoples to help on the project and drove others from their lands. After the builders left came someone who called himself the Guardian, and he, too, sought control over the native peoples.|C-3PO, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="TLC" />}}
The '''occupation of Wayland''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] occupation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]].<ref name="UAA" /> During the occupation, the Imperial [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] hollowed out [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]].<ref name="TTTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> Meanwhile, the native [[Myneyrsh]]i and [[Psadan]]s joined forces in an attempt to defeat the invaders.<ref name="UAA" /> The Myneyrshi soon found out that their [[Crossbow/Legends|crossbows]], while powerful, were not strong enough to pierce Imperial [[battle armor]].<ref name="HTTES">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Dismissing the natives' primitive bows and spears, the Emperor's engineers began constructing a vast network of chambers deep in the bowels of the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]]<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> and set up a maze of internal defenses.<ref name="TTTS" /> The Empire [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] the planet's indigenous population and put them to work building an immense complex beneath Mount Tantiss.<ref name="UAA" /> With the project complete, the engineers then withdrew.<ref name="TTTS" />

The Emperor refused to attract unwanted attention with a defensive [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]].<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> Instead, Palpatine put Mount Tantiss under the protection of a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Guardian of Mount Tantiss|Guardian]],<ref name="HttE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> and sealed the mountain.<ref name="TTTS" /> Eventually, according to the [[Psadan]], the Guardian sought control over the natives of Wayland.<ref name="TLC" />

By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the [[Imperial Research Station 61]] was established on the planet. There, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Milosh Muhrlein]], who was a [[Commandant/Legends|commandant]] in charge of the station, began selling the technology that his staff developed on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] as a means of maintaining a luxurious lifestyle that he otherwise could not afford. Muhrlein's shady dealings were eventually [[Mission to Imperial Research Station 61|discovered]] by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Jahan Cross]], who Muhrlein attempted to bribe into silence. When Muhrlein's efforts failed, he attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Cross, but he was unsuccessful and died in the attempt.<ref name="AotE">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]]</ref>

The Imperial occupation of Wayland ended shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="UAA" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC" />
